preconditions.description: The input string must be non-empty.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '()' for c in stdin)
preconditions.description: The input string must consist only of '(' and ')' characters.
The length of the input string must not exceed 10^6.

postconditions.description: The output must be the length of the longest regular bracket substring and the count of such substrings.
The length of the longest regular bracket substring must be non-negative.
The count of the longest regular bracket substrings must be at least 1.
